race.comment: TRANTORO (6) has been far from disgraced in her two runs back against stronger opposition. Profiles strongly for this third-up and is drawn cosy for Holder. Should take some beating. CHUR NIBBLE (1) was back to somewhere near his best here last week when stalking the speed and pouncing in the lane to score with a bit in hand. Backs up quickly and gets his chance to make it two on the bounce if he can hold his form. LOCA BELLA (10) drops back in trip off 49 days in-between runs but has kept the legs ticking over with a Morphettville trial. Has run into a red-hot Cradle Of Jazz in her last two, who has since won again. Deserves genuine consideration. VICTORY QUEEN (8) has been in solid form this prep, posting two wins from five starts. Carries a slight fitness edge over some of her main rivals and shoulders peaks that stack right up. Will need Murtagh on top of his game from a tricky draw. KORATORA (7) should bounce straight to the front and give a bold sight on the quick back-up.
